input.quote: For the acceptance period and for a period of one year from the Maintenance Commencement Date, and thereafter for as long as the Software is covered by Maintenance Services and is used by Sparkling in accordance with this Agreement, Garman warrants that the Software shall perform in conformance with the Specifications in all material respects.
input.rationale: The software conformance warranty duration (one year from the Maintenance Commencement Date, extended while under Maintenance) meets the preferred 12-month position, and there is no implied-warranty disclaimer anywhere in the Agreement, so the express warranty is not swallowed. However, Section 12 states no remedy for breach: the only warranty-adjacent remedies are the acceptance-period rejection right in Sections 7-8 (time-limited and "in lieu of any other remedy") and Software Repair Service under Section 10(c), which is only a "best efforts" obligation conditional on a paid maintenance subscription. There is also no warranty that Garman's services (installation, data conversion, training, maintenance) will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner, no compliance-with-laws warranty, and no no-malicious-code warranty. We therefore insert a single supplemental paragraph in Section 12 adding the services standard, a repair/replace/re-perform-or-refund remedy, compliance with laws and no malicious code, leaving the existing 12-month software warranty intact.

proposal.summary: Add services warranty, express warranty remedy (repair/replace/refund), compliance with laws and no malicious code to Section 12
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 12 gives us a twelve-month conformance warranty but no stated remedy and no warranty covering Garman's services, legal compliance or malicious code. We have added a professional and workmanlike standard for the Services, a repair/replace/refund remedy for breach, and standard compliance-with-laws and no-malicious-code warranties, consistent with our playbook position.

ops.text: Garman further warrants that: (a) all Services (including installation, data conversion, training and Maintenance Services) will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards, and for a period of ninety (90) days following performance will conform in all material respects to the applicable Specifications and Documentation; (b) it will comply with all laws applicable to its performance under this Agreement; and (c) the Software as delivered will be free of any virus, worm, time bomb, disabling device or other malicious code. If any Software, Deliverable or Service fails to conform to the warranties in this Section 12, Garman shall promptly repair, replace or re-perform the non-conforming item at no charge to Sparkling and, if Garman fails to do so within thirty (30) days of written notice, Garman shall refund the fees paid for the non-conforming Software, Deliverable or Service.
